minutes.headline: Selectmen kept a single tax rate, licensed a new pub, renewed the power consultant, and opened the special town meeting warrant.
minutes.summary: The board approved an all-alcohol license for Prime Time Pub, heard the assessor on exemptions and deferrals, and kept a uniform tax rate. It renewed the electricity aggregation consultant agreement and opened the warrant for the special town meeting on the school building project. It adopted its policies and procedures. A member raised unease about appropriating the full project cost while borrowing only the local share.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted to keep a single tax rate for all property classes, after the assessors said commercial and industrial property is a small part of the tax base.
The board opened the special town meeting warrant on November 12 and voted to close it November 25 at 4 pm.
The board approved an all-alcohol license for Prime Time Pub at 5 Summer Street, Unit 10, after a public hearing.
The board approved the electricity aggregation consultant agreement with Colonial Power Group; participating customers' winter rate is rising with regional market costs.
A motion to adopt the board's policies and procedures was made, but the result is not audible; the DPW road-opening policy was tabled.

why_it_matters: A single tax rate means homes and businesses are taxed at the same rate, so no part of the levy shifts onto commercial and industrial property.
The special town meeting warrant covers the school building project; voters will be asked to appropriate the full project cost, with the state grant reducing what the town borrows.
Residents in the electricity aggregation program will see a higher winter supply rate, and the consultant is paid through a per-kilowatt-hour fee built into that rate.
watch_next: The warrant closes November 25 at 4 pm; the special town meeting is set for January 7, and the board is to choose a snow date by next week.
The ballot question and warrant article are to be finalized once the superintendent supplies the project description, then sent to town counsel, bond counsel and the MSBA.
